other_text: In the early 1990s, a young couple and their child will face their worst nightmare... In an ancient forest, three friends set out on a weekend hike, but what they find is not what they expected... whatever has taken the children, we are all doomed.
description: A misty forest scene with a noose hanging from a tree, featuring the title 'THE WOODS' and author names Lachlan Reck and Eliza Jane.
